title: EcomDiscover
info: A collection of e-commerce resources. Primarily related to FBA, but also touching on many other aspects of e-commerce software and tools. Crowd-sourced searchable reviews from community.
info2: Front-end developed in React with Gatsby and Tailwind CSS. Back-end is a Firebase Cloud Firestore. User authentication through Firebase Authentication. React Hook Form enables users to submit, rate and review e-commerce tools & services.
